consumer: The frontend HP-bar renderer asking 'what colored health band (green/yellow/red) does the GUI display for this visible monster?' — a formatted view of the hp/hp_max ratio, not an engine check.
scope: per-visible-monster: each monster the avatar currently sees, rendered as the GUI's color-banded HP display (not applicable to inventory/map-region reach).
decisive_source: The GUI's HP-bar color-banding routine (engine's get_hp_bar / hp-bar formatting that buckets hp/hp_max into green/yellow/red) is NOT shown in the excerpts; Excerpt 1 src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_entities only emits raw hp/hp_max integers (S), and Excerpt 3 src/creature.cpp::Creature::sees only gates visibility — neither performs the GUI color banding the goal requires.
divergence: A monster whose hp/hp_max ratio sits exactly on a band boundary (or a near-dead monster the GUI clamps to red): a naive raw-ratio reproduction would round it to yellow/green while the GUI's actual banding shows red, exposing the display proxy diverging from raw state.
